scope: Natural native GPU render-callback cadence, not compositor presentation/FPS or GPU execution time.
clock_consistency_contract: The shader and callback ledger sample the same Instant. Offset variation <=1 ms permits f32 conversion; this is not a frame-rate threshold.
measurement_limits: One sequential before/after session pair on one Mac; no cross-platform guarantee or statistical significance claim.
First burst is separate from six warmed bursts. The first GPU draw can include a driver cold cost.
Typing uses 24 particles and Copy 12, so Copy is an unchanged-source control with a smaller GPU batch.
Each callback gap is classified by the later sample shader age: early <320 ms, late >=320 ms.
Input-producer duration includes native helper overhead and is not input-to-pixel latency.
No snapshot, screenshot, or application-inspection request occurs during each 0.9-second post-producer wait.
CPU queue/submission wall time and render callback times do not measure GPU completion, swap, or display presentation.
The timing ledger does not identify font-cache coldness or attribute remaining stalls to a specific subsystem.
Plain text has no displayed native preview; its recorded PDFium backend is only the inactive fallback label.
